bull_case: Current price is roughly half the locked Base value; AI-first ARR is now >$650M and TTM owner-style FCF/share is near the Base path starting point.
bear_case: Bear value is only modestly below current price and terminal value remains material; if AI commoditizes workflows, the locked long-run FCF path could prove too optimistic.
thesis: The deterministic valuation signal is unchanged: $248.92 / locked Base $495.57 = ~0.502x, mapping to 90 for reverse-DCF burden and 85 for Base return. New evidence supports, but does not rewrite, the frozen owner-FCF paths: TTM owner-style FCF after capex and SBC is estimated at ~$21.44/share and AI-first ending ARR exceeds $650M. Valuation robustness remains 70 because terminal value is material and Firefly-specific economics/incrementality remain unknown.

evidence.claim: Locked Bear/Base/Bull values are ~$233.72/$495.57/$817.33 at the frozen $248.92 price; price/Base is ~0.502x.
TTM owner-style FCF after capex and SBC is estimated at ~$8.521B, or ~$21.44/share using frozen 397.5M shares.
Q3 AI-first ending ARR exceeded $650M and grew >150% y/y.
Q3 revenue was $6.760B (+13% y/y) and OCF was $2.523B.

counterevidence: Bear value (~$233.72) is only modestly below the frozen current price, so a structural moat break can remove the apparent margin of safety.
Base and Bull still rely materially on terminal value.
Firefly-specific inference economics and AI-first ARR incrementality remain undisclosed.
unknowns: Firefly contribution margin and AI-first ARR incrementality.
Whether the locked Base owner-FCF/share growth path survives a full AI competition cycle.
falsifiers: Owner-style FCF/share falls materially below the Bear path for multiple periods.
AI monetization fails to offset erosion in core creative/document subscription economics.
A lower terminal multiple or weaker normalized FCF removes most of the Base discount.
